newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK Prop shares drop on placement rumours.
newsitem.headline: SHK Prop shares drop on placement rumours.

text.p: Shares of Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd fell in late trade on rumours of a share placement, brokers said on Tuesday.
A spokeswoman from Sun Hung Kai Properties denied the placement rumours, saying "there is no such thing".
The company shares fell HK$1.00 to end Tuesday at HK$92.25 on volume of 2.98 million shares worth HK$278.83 million.
Shares of HSBC Holdings Plc also dropped on placement rumours, brokers said. The shares fell HK$2.00 to end at HK$158.00 each.
"We are aware of the rumour but as a matter of policy, we cannot comment on speculation," said Bob Sherbin, senior external relation manager of HSBC group's public affair.
"If there was placement, we would be obligated to make a statement," Sherbin said.
"Investors might be trying to find an excuse to sell down the shares after their recent rally," said one sale manager at regional brokerage.
